title: At the End of the Earth: The Finnish Meänkieli People of Sweden
text: The Meänkieli and the Sami languages are both of the Uralic language group (as is Finnish) but are mutually unintelligible. The Tornedalens were peasant agriculturalists while the Sami were (and many still are) herders of reindeer and they obtain a good part of their diet from hunting and fishing.
